headline: Israeli Property Developer G City Puts $350 Million US Portfolio Up for Sale
summary: Real estate group G City disclosed it has put $350 million worth of commercial property assets in the United States up for sale as it exits the market.
why: G City is a international retail real estate owner headquartered in Israel, focused on debt reduction and core market concentration.

impacts.name: G City
impacts.why: G City put $350 million in US commercial real estate assets up for sale to exit US operations.
